description: Überschwemmungsgebiet Blies 2018 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Blies floodplain 2018; object under consideration in the GDZ; A new category ‘Re-establishment of floodplains’ The other floodplains will follow successively in the coming years. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding area Blies 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Planungsunterlagen/Kataster, Gewässernetze, Hochwasserschutz, Überschwemmung, geoportal, Saarland. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
